name: acd-l5x-js-poc
description: JS/Node port of the acd-tools ACD binary parser and L5X exporter, building toward a standalone offline browser-based ACD-to-L5X converter (see README.md for scope/status). Ported field-for-field from the mature Python implementation in ../acd.

scripts.test: node extract.js && node test_parse.js && node verify_records.js && node verify_ingest.js
